note: کوئری‌های گزارشِ «آزمایشِ reading_model_ds، روزِ پنجم» (۳ مهر ۱۴۰۵). قاعده‌ی آهنین: هیچ عددی از حافظه. main یک کوئریِ UNION ALLِ کلیددار است (ستونِ k)؛ ردیف‌های k=txt متنِ خامِ سؤال و فال دارند، پس این کوئری **فقط** از مسیرِ Ops → db-query-sealed اجرا شود (هرگز db-query: لاگِ جاب وقتی ریپو public است برای همه خواناست).

db.eval: bots/tarot/data/bot-fa.db (app=tarot, only=bot-fa.db, action=db-query؛ فقط عددِ تجمیعی، پس db-query ساده کافی است)
db.cost_scenarios: bots/tarot/data/bot-fa.db (app=tarot, only=bot-fa.db, action=db-query؛ فقط عددِ تجمیعی)

excludeUsers: مالک و حساب‌های تست، همان لیستِ state.json (داخلِ کوئری هاردکد شده)
howToRun: node tools/ops-unseal.mjs keygen <scratchpad> ⟵ dispatch ops.yml با action=db-query-sealed, app=tarot, pubkey=<خروجی>, query=<main> ⟵ دانلودِ لاگ ⟵ node tools/ops-unseal.mjs open <key> <log> out.json. کلید و out.json فقط در scratchpad و بعد از کار پاک.
perf: روی bot-fa.db (~۳۶۶MB) زیرِ سقفِ ۳۰۰ ثانیه تمام شد به‌شرطِ CTEهای AS MATERIALIZED؛ بدونِ آن‌ها readings per کاربر دوباره اسکن می‌شد.

queries.main:
WITH
st AS (SELECT started_at s FROM experiments WHERE key='reading_model_ds'),
nw AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) t, CAST((CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER) d),
w0 AS (SELECT MIN((SELECT s FROM st) - 3600, (SELECT t FROM nw) - 31*86400) w),
fp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT user_id uid, MIN(created_at) fpt FROM payments WHERE status='approved' GROUP BY user_id),
ex AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.user_id uid, x.variant arm, x.created_at xt, CAST((x.created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER) xd,
         CASE WHEN u.created_at >= (SELECT s FROM st) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END nu,
         CASE WHEN fp.fpt < x.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END pb,
         CASE WHEN u.first_source LIKE 'campaign:%' THEN 'cam' WHEN u.first_source LIKE 'referral%' OR u.first_source LIKE 'ref%' THEN 'ref' WHEN COALESCE(u.first_source,'')='' THEN 'unk' ELSE 'org' END src
  FROM ab_exposures x JOIN users u ON u.telegram_id = x.user_id LEFT JOIN fp ON fp.uid = x.user_id
  WHERE x.experiment_key='reading_model_ds' AND x.user_id NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933)
),
lu AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, ref_id, kind, model, cost_usd, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, ms, user_id, created_at FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= (SELECT w FROM w0)),
rc AS (
  SELECT ref_id rid, SUM(cost_usd) usd,
         SUM(kind='reading') att, SUM(kind='repair') rep,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='repair' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) usd_rep,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' THEN prompt_tokens ELSE 0 END) tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' THEN completion_tokens ELSE 0 END) tout,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' THEN cached_tokens ELSE 0 END) tcache,
         SUM(kind='reading' AND model LIKE 'deepseek/deepseek-v4%') dsn,
         SUM(kind='reading' AND model LIKE 'openai/%') lun,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' AND model LIKE 'deepseek/deepseek-v4%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) usd_ds,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' THEN ms ELSE 0 END) lms
  FROM lu WHERE kind IN ('reading','repair') AND ref_id > 0 GROUP BY ref_id
),
sm AS (SELECT rid, model, ms FROM (SELECT ref_id rid, model, ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref_id ORDER BY id DESC) rn FROM lu WHERE kind='reading' AND ref_id > 0) WHERE rn=1),
rwe AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CAST(json_extract(e.props,'$.reading_id') AS INTEGER) rid, json_extract(e.props,'$.arm') arm, CAST(json_extract(e.props,'$.ms') AS REAL) ms, e.user_id uid
  FROM events e WHERE e.event='reading_wait' AND e.created_at >= (SELECT s FROM st) - 60 AND e.user_id NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933)
),
rw AS (SELECT rid, MIN(arm) arm, MAX(ms) ms, COUNT(*) nwv FROM rwe GROUP BY rid),
fr AS (SELECT user_id uid, MIN(id) fid FROM readings GROUP BY user_id),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.id rid, r.user_id uid, r.price sz, r.status, r.feedback fb, r.created_at t, LENGTH(r.llm_json) lj,
         CASE WHEN r.question_audio <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END au,
         CASE WHEN fr.fid = r.id AND (fp.fpt IS NULL OR fp.fpt > r.created_at) AND r.price <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ff,
         CASE WHEN fp.fpt IS NULL OR fp.fpt > r.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END np,
         CASE WHEN r.created_at >= (SELECT s FROM st) - 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END inx,
         COALESCE(rw.arm,'none') arm, rw.ms ms,
         COALESCE(rc.usd,0) usd, COALESCE(rc.att,0) att, COALESCE(rc.rep,0) rep, COALESCE(rc.usd_rep,0) usd_rep,
         COALESCE(rc.tin,0) tin, COALESCE(rc.tout,0) tout, COALESCE(rc.tcache,0) tcache,
         COALESCE(rc.dsn,0) dsn, COALESCE(rc.lun,0) lun, COALESCE(rc.usd_ds,0) usd_ds, sm.ms sms,
         CASE WHEN r.feedback LIKE 'rate:%' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.feedback,6) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END sc,
         CASE WHEN sm.model LIKE 'deepseek/deepseek-v4%' THEN 'ds4' WHEN sm.model LIKE 'deepseek/%' THEN 'ds3' WHEN sm.model LIKE 'openai/%' THEN 'luna'
              WHEN sm.model LIKE 'google/%' THEN 'gem' WHEN sm.model IS NULL THEN 'nocall' ELSE 'other' END mf
  FROM readings r LEFT JOIN fr ON fr.uid = r.user_id LEFT JOIN fp ON fp.uid = r.user_id
       LEFT JOIN rw ON rw.rid = r.id LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.rid = r.id LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.rid = r.id
  WHERE r.created_at >= (SELECT w FROM w0) AND r.user_id NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933)
),
pay AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, user_id, amount, created_at FROM payments WHERE status='approved'),
pa AS (
  SELECT ex.uid, COUNT(p.id) npay, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) rev, MIN(p.created_at) p1t,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.created_at < ex.xt+86400 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) rev24,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.created_at < ex.xt+259200 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) rev72
  FROM ex JOIN pay p ON p.user_id=ex.uid AND p.created_at>=ex.xt GROUP BY ex.uid
),
ea AS (
  SELECT ex.uid,
    SUM(e.event='product_delivered') nd,
    SUM(e.event='product_delivered' AND e.created_at < ex.xt+172800) nd48,
    SUM(e.event='refund') nref, SUM(e.event='payment_rejected') nrej,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event IN ('daily_card','lucky_card','product_delivered') THEN (e.created_at+12600)/86400 END) adays,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event IN ('daily_card','lucky_card','product_delivered') THEN (e.created_at+12600)/86400 END) lastd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event IN ('daily_card','lucky_card','product_delivered') AND (e.created_at+12600)/86400 = ex.xd+1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) u1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event IN ('daily_card','lucky_card','product_delivered') AND (e.created_at+12600)/86400 BETWEEN ex.xd+1 AND ex.xd+3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) u13,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event='product_delivered' AND (e.created_at+12600)/86400 BETWEEN ex.xd+1 AND ex.xd+3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r13,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event='product_delivered' AND (e.created_at+12600)/86400 >= ex.xd+1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rlater
  FROM ex JOIN events e ON e.user_id=ex.uid AND e.created_at>=ex.xt
   AND e.event IN ('product_delivered','refund','payment_rejected','daily_card','lucky_card')
  GROUP BY ex.uid
),
uc AS (SELECT ex.uid, SUM(l.cost_usd) ucost FROM ex JOIN lu l ON l.user_id=ex.uid AND l.created_at>=ex.xt-900 GROUP BY ex.uid),
rs AS (
  SELECT ex.uid, COUNT(*) nr, SUM(r.sz) dia, SUM(r.sz>3) big
  FROM ex JOIN rg r ON r.uid=ex.uid AND r.t >= ex.xt-900 AND r.status IN ('delivered','started','paid') GROUP BY ex.uid
),
xu AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ex.uid, ex.arm, ex.xt, ex.xd, ex.nu, ex.pb, ex.src,
    COALESCE(pa.npay,0) npay, COALESCE(pa.rev,0) rev, pa.p1t p1t, COALESCE(pa.rev24,0) rev24, COALESCE(pa.rev72,0) rev72,
    COALESCE(ea.nd,0) nd, COALESCE(ea.nd48,0) nd48, COALESCE(ea.nref,0) nref, COALESCE(ea.nrej,0) nrej,
    COALESCE(ea.adays,0) adays, ea.lastd lastd, COALESCE(ea.u1,0) u1, COALESCE(ea.u13,0) u13, COALESCE(ea.r13,0) r13, COALESCE(ea.rlater,0) rlater,
    COALESCE(uc.ucost,0) ucost, COALESCE(rs.nr,0) nr, COALESCE(rs.dia,0) dia, COALESCE(rs.big,0) big
  FROM ex LEFT JOIN pa ON pa.uid=ex.uid LEFT JOIN ea ON ea.uid=ex.uid LEFT JOIN uc ON uc.uid=ex.uid LEFT JOIN rs ON rs.uid=ex.uid
),
fbe AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ex.arm, CAST(json_extract(e.props,'$.score') AS INTEGER) sc
  FROM ex JOIN events e ON e.user_id=ex.uid
  WHERE e.event='feedback' AND e.created_at>=ex.xt AND json_extract(e.props,'$.score') IS NOT NULL
),
wq AS (SELECT arm, ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY arm ORDER BY ms) rk, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY arm) cnt FROM rwe WHERE ms IS NOT NULL),
adm AS (SELECT 429557996 u UNION ALL SELECT 409581917 UNION ALL SELECT 100257975 UNION ALL SELECT 5725984933),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT g.rid, g.uid, g.arm, g.mf, g.sc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.uid ORDER BY (g.rid*7919)%10007) rn
  FROM rg g WHERE g.status='delivered' AND g.inx=1 AND g.au=0 AND ((g.arm='ds' AND g.mf='ds4') OR (g.arm='control' AND g.mf='luna'))
),
pick AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf, 'rnd' why FROM (SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf FROM cand WHERE rn=1 AND arm='ds' ORDER BY (rid*104729)%10007 LIMIT 90)
  UNION ALL SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf, 'rnd' FROM (SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf FROM cand WHERE rn=1 AND arm='control' ORDER BY (rid*104729)%10007 LIMIT 45)
  UNION ALL SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf, 'low' FROM (SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf FROM cand WHERE sc BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND arm='ds' ORDER BY rid DESC LIMIT 25)
  UNION ALL SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf, 'low' FROM (SELECT rid, uid, arm, mf FROM cand WHERE sc BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND arm='control' ORDER BY rid DESC LIMIT 25)
),
rall AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, user_id, type, summary, feedback, status FROM readings WHERE user_id IN (SELECT uid FROM pick))
SELECT 'meta' k, status a, started_at n, variants_json v1, (SELECT t FROM nw) v2, (SELECT d FROM nw) v3, (SELECT w FROM w0) v4 FROM experiments WHERE key='reading_model_ds'
UNION ALL SELECT 'exp', arm, COUNT(*), MIN(xt), MAX(xt), SUM(nu), AVG(xt) FROM ex GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'bal', arm || ':' || src || ':nu' || nu || ':pb' || pb, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ex GROUP BY arm, src, nu, pb
UNION ALL SELECT 'conv', arm || ':nu' || nu || ':pb' || pb, COUNT(*), SUM(npay>0), SUM(npay), SUM(rev), SUM(ucost) FROM xu GROUP BY arm, nu, pb
UNION ALL SELECT 'convw', arm, SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-86400), SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-86400 AND p1t IS NOT NULL AND p1t < xt+86400), SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-259200), SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-259200 AND p1t IS NOT NULL AND p1t < xt+259200), SUM(CASE WHEN xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-259200 THEN rev72 ELSE 0 END) FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', arm, COUNT(*), SUM(nd>=1), SUM(nd>=2), SUM(nd>=3), SUM(nd) FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret48', arm, SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-172800), SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-172800 AND nd48>=2), SUM(xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-172800 AND nd48>=1), SUM(CASE WHEN xt <= (SELECT t FROM nw)-172800 THEN nd48 ELSE 0 END), NULL FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'd1', arm, SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-2), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-2 AND u1=1), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-4), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-4 AND u13=1), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-4 AND r13=1) FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'stick', arm, SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-3), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-3 AND adays>=2), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-3 AND adays>=3), SUM(xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-3 AND lastd >= (SELECT d FROM nw)-1), AVG(CASE WHEN xd <= (SELECT d FROM nw)-3 THEN adays END) FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'spend', arm, COUNT(*), SUM(nr), SUM(dia), SUM(big), SUM(rlater) FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'guard', arm, SUM(nref>0), SUM(nref), SUM(nrej>0), SUM(nrej), NULL FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'fb_ev', arm, COUNT(*), AVG(sc), SUM(sc<=2), SUM(sc=5), SUM(sc=4) FROM fbe GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'fbd', arm || ':' || sc, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM fbe GROUP BY arm, sc
UNION ALL SELECT 'fb_rd', arm || ':' || mf, SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(sc>0), AVG(CASE WHEN sc>0 THEN sc END), SUM(sc>0 AND sc<=2), SUM(sc=5) FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY arm, mf
UNION ALL SELECT 'fb_ff', arm || ':ff' || ff, SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(sc>0), AVG(CASE WHEN sc>0 THEN sc END), SUM(sc>0 AND sc<=2), AVG(usd) FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY arm, ff
UNION ALL SELECT 'wait', arm, MAX(cnt), AVG(ms), MAX(CASE WHEN rk = CAST(0.5*cnt AS INTEGER) + (0.5*cnt > CAST(0.5*cnt AS INTEGER)) THEN ms END), MAX(CASE WHEN rk = CAST(0.9*cnt AS INTEGER) + (0.9*cnt > CAST(0.9*cnt AS INTEGER)) THEN ms END), MAX(CASE WHEN rk = CAST(0.99*cnt AS INTEGER) + (0.99*cnt > CAST(0.99*cnt AS INTEGER)) THEN ms END) FROM wq GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'wait_tail', arm, COUNT(*), SUM(ms>0), SUM(ms>20000), SUM(ms>60000), SUM(ms>120000) FROM rwe GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'model', arm || ':' || mf, COUNT(*), AVG(usd), AVG(att), SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(status='refunded') FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY arm, mf
UNION ALL SELECT 'attd', arm || ':' || mf || ':a' || MIN(att,4) || ':d' || MIN(dsn,3), COUNT(*), AVG(usd), AVG(sms), NULL, NULL FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY arm, mf, MIN(att,4), MIN(dsn,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'st', arm || ':' || status, COUNT(*), AVG(usd), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rg WHERE inx=1 GROUP BY arm, status
UNION ALL SELECT 'size', arm || ':' || sz, COUNT(*), AVG(usd), AVG(att), AVG(rep), AVG(usd_rep) FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY arm, sz
UNION ALL SELECT 'tok', arm || ':' || mf || ':' || sz, COUNT(*), AVG(tin), AVG(tout), AVG(tcache), AVG(usd) FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') AND att=1 AND rep=0 GROUP BY arm, mf, sz
UNION ALL SELECT 'lat', arm || ':' || mf, COUNT(*), AVG(sms), MAX(sms), AVG(ms), NULL FROM rg WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') AND sms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arm, mf
UNION ALL SELECT 'len', mf || ':' || sz, COUNT(*), AVG(lj), MIN(lj), MAX(lj), NULL FROM rg WHERE status='delivered' AND inx=1 AND mf IN ('ds4','luna') GROUP BY mf, sz
UNION ALL SELECT 'glob', arm || ':ff' || ff || ':au' || au || ':' || sz, COUNT(*), SUM(usd), SUM(usd_rep), SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(att) FROM rg WHERE inx=1 GROUP BY arm, ff, au, sz
UNION ALL SELECT 'mix30', 'ff' || ff || ':np' || np || ':au' || au || ':' || sz || ':' || mf, COUNT(*), SUM(usd), SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(usd_rep), NULL FROM rg WHERE t >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 30*86400 GROUP BY ff, np, au, sz, mf
UNION ALL SELECT 'kind', kind, COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd), MIN(created_at), MAX(created_at), SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IN (SELECT u FROM adm) THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM lu WHERE created_at >= (SELECT s FROM st) GROUP BY kind
UNION ALL SELECT 'kind30', kind, COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd), MIN(created_at), MAX(created_at), SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IN (SELECT u FROM adm) THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) FROM lu WHERE created_at >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 30*86400 GROUP BY kind
UNION ALL SELECT 'dcost', CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER), COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd), SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reading' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IN (SELECT u FROM adm) THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), NULL FROM lu WHERE created_at >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 31*86400 GROUP BY CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER)
UNION ALL SELECT 'drev', CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER), COUNT(*), SUM(amount), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), NULL, NULL FROM payments WHERE status='approved' AND created_at >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 31*86400 AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT u FROM adm) GROUP BY CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dusr', CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER), COUNT(*), SUM(first_source LIKE 'campaign:%'), SUM(first_source LIKE 'ref%'), NULL, NULL FROM users WHERE created_at >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 45*86400 AND telegram_id NOT IN (SELECT u FROM adm) GROUP BY CAST((created_at+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER)
UNION ALL SELECT 'drd', CAST((t+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER), COUNT(*), SUM(status='delivered'), SUM(usd), SUM(au), SUM(ff) FROM rg WHERE t >= (SELECT t FROM nw) - 31*86400 GROUP BY CAST((t+12600)/86400 AS INTEGER)
UNION ALL SELECT 'noneX', mf || ':' || status, COUNT(*), SUM(usd), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rg WHERE arm='none' AND inx=1 AND au=0 GROUP BY mf, status
UNION ALL SELECT 'xp', ex.arm || ':' || p.experiment_key || ':' || p.variant, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ex JOIN ab_exposures p ON p.user_id=ex.uid AND p.experiment_key IN ('price_ladder_p3','price_ladder_p4_basic_25','money_cta_style_v1') GROUP BY ex.arm, p.experiment_key, p.variant
UNION ALL SELECT 'exps', key, status, started_at, variants_json, NULL, NULL FROM experiments WHERE status IN ('running','draining') OR key LIKE 'price_ladder_p4%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'rwdup', arm, COUNT(*), SUM(nwv>1), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rw GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'rev_all', '', COUNT(*), SUM(amount), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM payments WHERE status='approved' AND created_at >= (SELECT s FROM st) AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT u FROM adm)
UNION ALL SELECT 'pu', arm, COUNT(*), GROUP_CONCAT(xd || '|' || nu || '|' || pb || '|' || src || '|' || (rev/1000) || '|' || npay || '|' || nd || '|' || nd48 || '|' || adays || '|' || u1 || '|' || u13 || '|' || r13 || '|' || CAST(ROUND(ucost*100000) AS INTEGER) || '|' || nref || '|' || nr || '|' || dia || '|' || big || '|' || CASE WHEN p1t IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE (p1t - xt) END, ';'), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM xu GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'pr', arm, COUNT(*), GROUP_CONCAT(mf || '|' || sz || '|' || ff || '|' || np || '|' || au || '|' || status || '|' || CAST(ROUND(usd*100000) AS INTEGER) || '|' || att || '|' || rep || '|' || dsn || '|' || lun || '|' || sc || '|' || COALESCE(CAST(ms AS INTEGER),-1) || '|' || COALESCE(sms,-1) || '|' || COALESCE(lj,0) || '|' || CAST(ROUND(usd_ds*100000) AS INTEGER), ';'), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rg WHERE inx=1 GROUP BY arm
UNION ALL SELECT 'txt', p.arm || ':' || p.mf || ':' || p.why, r.id, r.llm_json, r.cards_json, r.question, json_object('type', r.type, 'price', r.price, 'fb', r.feedback, 't', r.created_at, 'att', g.att, 'rep', g.rep, 'usd', g.usd, 'sms', g.sms, 'ms', g.ms, 'sc', g.sc, 'np', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rall x WHERE x.user_id=r.user_id AND x.id<r.id AND x.status='delivered'), 'prevs', (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('type', type, 'summary', summary, 'feedback', feedback)) FROM (SELECT x.type, x.summary, x.feedback FROM rall x WHERE x.user_id=r.user_id AND x.id<r.id AND x.status='delivered' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 4))) FROM pick p JOIN readings r ON r.id=p.rid JOIN rg g ON g.rid=p.rid

queries.cost_scenarios: WITH st AS (SELECT started_at AS t0, stopped_at AS t1 FROM experiments WHERE key='reading_model_ds'), win0 AS (SELECT ((t0 + 12600) / 86400 + 1) * 86400 - 12600 AS ws0, ((MIN(CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER), COALESCE(t1, 9000000000)) + 12600) / 86400) * 86400 - 12600 AS we FROM st), win AS (SELECT MAX(ws0, we - 7 * 86400) AS ws, we FROM win0), u AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT user_id AS luid, kind, ref_id, model, cost_usd FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= (SELECT ws FROM win) AND created_at < (SELECT we FROM win) ), refs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT ref_id AS rid FROM u WHERE ref_id > 0), ru AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS uid FROM readings WHERE id IN (SELECT rid FROM refs)), wb AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT user_id AS uid, MAX(CAST(json_extract(props,'$.amount') AS INTEGER)) AS w FROM events WHERE user_id IN (SELECT uid FROM ru) AND event = 'credit_granted' AND json_extract(props,'$.kind') = 'welcome' GROUP BY user_id ), fp AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT user_id AS uid, MIN(created_at) AS fpt FROM payments WHERE status = 'approved' AND user_id IN (SELECT uid FROM ru) GROUP BY user_id ), ur AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, user_id, price, status, created_at, CASE WHEN COALESCE(question_audio,'') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS au FROM readings WHERE user_id IN (SELECT uid FROM ru) ), seq AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, user_id, price, status, created_at, au, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','started','delivered','canceled') THEN price ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS before FROM ur ), rw AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT CAST(json_extract(props,'$.reading_id') AS INTEGER) AS rid, MIN(json_extract(props,'$.arm')) AS arm, COUNT(*) AS nw FROM events WHERE event = 'reading_wait' AND created_at >= (SELECT t0 FROM st) - 60 GROUP BY 1 ), ex AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT user_id AS uid, variant FROM ab_exposures WHERE experiment_key = 'reading_model_ds'), rc AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ref_id AS rid, SUM(cost_usd) AS usd, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('reading','repair') THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS usd_rr, MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'reading' AND model LIKE 'deepseek/deepseek-v4%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasds FROM u WHERE ref_id > 0 AND luid NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933) GROUP BY ref_id ), x AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s.id, s.price, s.au, rc.usd, rc.calls, rc.usd_rr, rc.hasds, COALESCE(rw.nw, 0) AS nw, CASE WHEN s.price > 0 THEN MAX(0, MIN(s.price, COALESCE(wb.w, 0) - s.before)) * 1.0 / s.price ELSE 0 END AS f, CASE WHEN fp.fpt IS NULL OR fp.fpt > s.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS np, CASE WHEN s.au = 1 THEN 'audio' WHEN s.created_at < (SELECT t0 FROM st) THEN 'pre' WHEN rw.arm IN ('control','ds') THEN rw.arm ELSE 'u_' || COALESCE(ex.variant, 'none') END AS arm FROM seq s JOIN rc ON rc.rid = s.id LEFT JOIN wb ON wb.uid = s.user_id LEFT JOIN fp ON fp.uid = s.user_id LEFT JOIN rw ON rw.rid = s.id LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.uid = s.user_id WHERE s.user_id NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933) ), y AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x.*, CASE WHEN f > 0 THEN 'w' WHEN np = 1 THEN 'g' ELSE 'p' END AS seg FROM x) SELECT 'W_window' AS k, date((ws + 12600) / 86400 * 86400, 'unixepoch') || '..' || date((we + 12600) / 86400 * 86400 - 86400, 'unixepoch') || ' [' || ws || ',' || we || ')' AS grp, (we - ws) / 86400 AS n, NULL AS usd, NULL AS usd_rr, NULL AS n_hasds FROM win UNION ALL SELECT 'A_all_nonadmin', '', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),5), NULL, NULL FROM u WHERE luid NOT IN (429557996,409581917,100257975,5725984933) UNION ALL SELECT 'B_matched', '', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(usd),5), ROUND(SUM(usd_rr),5), SUM(calls) FROM y UNION ALL SELECT 'C_seg_arm', seg || ':' || arm, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(usd),5), ROUND(SUM(usd_rr),5), SUM(hasds) FROM y GROUP BY seg, arm UNION ALL SELECT 'D_seg_arm_size', seg || ':' || arm || ':' || price, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(usd),5), ROUND(SUM(usd_rr),5), SUM(hasds) FROM y WHERE arm IN ('control','ds') GROUP BY seg, arm, price UNION ALL SELECT 'E_price0', seg, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(usd),5), NULL, NULL FROM y WHERE price = 0 GROUP BY seg UNION ALL SELECT 'F_multiwait', '', SUM(nw > 1), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM y UNION ALL SELECT 'G_exp', status || ':' || COALESCE(started_at,'') || ':' || variants_json, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM experiments WHERE key = 'reading_model_ds' UNION ALL SELECT 'H_by_model_all', model, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),5), NULL, NULL FROM u GROUP BY model

evalNote: کوئری‌های eval و cost_scenarios برای ارزیابیِ دوباره‌ی آزمایش (تصمیمِ مالک در ۳ مهر ۱۴۰۵: حداقل ۱۰ روزِ دیگر running، زودترین ارزیابی ۱۳ مهر) ساخته شدند. هر دو فقط عددِ تجمیعی می‌دهند و هیچ متن یا ردیفِ per کاربری ندارند، پس از مسیرِ db-queryِ ساده اجرا می‌شوند. eval تعریف‌های main را عیناً نگه می‌دارد (روی دیتابیسِ ساختگی ۶۱۵ از ۶۱۵ مقدارِ مشترک برابر بود) و خروجی را به‌شکلِ یک ردیف per کلید با JSONِ نام‌دار می‌دهد تا از سقفِ ۲۰۰ ردیفِ db-query رد نشود. پنجره‌ی هر دو خودکار است و اگر آزمایش stopped یا draining شود، در stopped_at بریده می‌شود. راهنما و تعریفِ هر فیلد: analytics/tarot/briefs/reading-model-ds-reevaluation.md. نسخه‌ی خوانا: analytics/tarot/queries/reading-model-ds-eval.sql و reading-model-ds-cost.sql.
